remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.hint: This stops the plugin, removes its tools and notification channels, and deletes its code directory and settings. Its data and history are kept.

settings.hint: Save after changing settings. A manual reload uses the saved settings and rereads the plugin's code and setting definitions.
settings.title: Plugin settings

enable.help: After saving, the plugin loads and registers its tools and notification channels.
enable.label: Enable plugin

keepOld: If it was running before, the old instance keeps running.
legacyHint: Uses the old plugin.toml plugin API
empty: No plugins found yet. Upload a ZIP, install from GitHub, or put one in the plugin directory and click Reload plugins.
removed: Plugin removed. The plugin list is updated.

install.idLabel: ID of the plugin to install
install.hint: Plugins run in the same process as ShiritaiBot, so only install plugins you trust. New plugins start disabled: configure them, enable them, and save.
install.title: Install plugin

installed: Plugin installed. Configure and enable it.
reloaded: Rescanned and reloaded plugins. Check each plugin's status.
title: Plugin management
